scope: SmartDoc DOCX to WPS old-system unsupported contract and current enhancement boundary

paragraphs: This document checks DOCX to WPS support boundaries.

docwen-ref-tk.stderr_contains: 不支持的转换: docx → wps

docwen-ref-pyside6.stderr_contains: 不支持的转换: docx → wps

current_rewrite.entry: uv run docwen run smart-doc-wps-boundary.docx --to wps --output <dir> --json

notes: Old Tk and old PySide6 batch-register the document-format wps target but their SmartConverter execution layer has no docx to wps branch and returns no output.
Current rewrite can emit a .wps target by saving a Word 97-2003/OLE document and renaming the produced bridge output to .wps.

Because old systems do not have a successful DOCX to WPS artifact baseline, DOCX to WPS should not remain a required old-system artifact blocker for GOLDEN-009. WPS inbound routes and current enhancement quality remain separate product-scope evidence.
